      "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strict read-only readiness for an existing configured host."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import pwd
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time

label = json.load(sys.stdin)["host_label"]
home = Path(pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir)
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
clock = time.monotonic()
errors = []
def metadata(path):
    p = Path(path)
    try:
        st = p.lstat()
        result = {"path": str(p), "exists": True, "mode": oct(stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)),
                  "is_symlink": stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode), "is_directory": stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode),
                  "is_regular": stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode), "size": st.st_size,
                  "st_blocks": st.st_blocks, "st_dev": st.st_dev, "inode": st.st_ino,
                  "nlink": st.st_nlink, "uid": st.st_uid, "gid": st.st_gid, "mtime_ns": st.st_mtime_ns}
        if p.is_symlink():
            result["link_target"] = os.readlink(p)
        return result
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {"path": str(p), "exists": False}
    except OSError as e:
        return {"path": str(p), "exists": None, "error_type": type(e).__name__, "errno": e.errno}
def filesystem(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_dir():
        return {"path": str(p), "exists_as_directory": False}
    st, v = p.stat(), os.statvfs(p)
    return {"path": str(p), "exists_as_directory": True, "st_dev": st.st_dev,
            "major_minor": f"{os.major(st.st_dev)}:{os.minor(st.st_dev)}",
            "f_bsize": v.f_bsize, "f_frsize": v.f_frsize, "f_blocks": v.f_blocks,
            "f_bfree": v.f_bfree, "f_bavail": v.f_bavail,
            "user_available_bytes": v.f_bavail * v.f_frsize, "free_bytes_including_reserved": v.f_bfree * v.f_frsize}
def version(argv):
    began = time.monotonic()
    r = subprocess.run(argv, cwd="/", stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, check=False,
                       env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    return {"argv": argv, "exit_code": r.returncode, "duration_seconds": time.monotonic() - began,
            "stdout": r.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
            "stderr": r.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")}
def file_identity(path):
    p = Path(path).resolve()
    st = p.stat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
        return {"path": str(p), "regular": False}
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open("rb") as stream:
        prefix = stream.read(4)
        h.update(prefix)
        while block := stream.read(1048576):
            h.update(block)
    return {"path": str(p), "bytes": st.st_size, "sha256": h.hexdigest(),
            "ELF": prefix == b"\x7fELF", "executable": os.access(p, os.X_OK)}

tools = []
seen_probe = {}
for name in ("git", "cargo", "rustc", "just", "cargo-nextest", "bazel"):
    selected = shutil.which(name)
    paths = ([Path(selected)] if selected else []) + [d / name for d in tool_dirs]
    entries = []
    seen = set()
    for path in paths:
        if str(path) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(str(path))
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        try:
            ident = file_identity(path)
            row = {"entry": metadata(path), "resolved_file": ident,
                   "selected_by_inherited_PATH": selected == str(path)}
            resolved = Path(ident["path"])
            safe_native = ident.get("ELF") and ident.get("executable") and name not in {"cargo", "rustc", "bazel"}
            known_bazel = (name == "bazel" and ident.get("sha256") ==
                           "d302d22ed77ee5658b87857249baa579db84300ecebe0a1e9a357b5b20f80eb8")
            if safe_native or known_bazel:
                key = (str(resolved), "--version")
                if key not in seen_probe:
                    seen_probe[key] = version([str(path), "--version"])
                row["version_probe"] = seen_probe[key]
            elif name in {"cargo", "rustc"}:
                row["version_not_run_on_this_entry"] = "Rustup/shim selection is not invoked; concrete already-installed toolchain bins are probed separately."
            else:
                row["version_not_run_on_this_entry"] = "Unknown wrapper or Bazel launcher is not executed, to avoid bootstrap or download."
            entries.append(row)

    tools.append({"name": name, "inherited_PATH_selection": selected, "observed_existing_entries": entries})

installed_toolchain_names = []
if toolchain_root.is_dir() and not toolchain_root.is_symlink():
    with os.scandir(toolchain_root) as it:
        for entry in it:
            if entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                installed_toolchain_names.append(entry.name)
installed_toolchain_names.sort()
preferred = [n for n in installed_toolchain_names if n.startswith("1.95.0")]
preferred += [n for n in installed_toolchain_names if n.startswith("stable-") and n not in preferred]
preferred += [n for n in installed_toolchain_names if n not in preferred]
toolchain_probes = []
for name in preferred[:4]:
    directory = toolchain_root / name
    row = {"name": name, "directory": metadata(directory), "versions": []}
    for binary, args in (("cargo", ["--version"]), ("rustc", ["-vV"])):
        p = directory / "bin" / binary
        if p.is_file():
            identity = file_identity(p)
            if identity.get("ELF") and identity.get("executable"):
                row["versions"].append({"binary": binary, "file": identity, "probe": version([str(p), *args])})
    toolchain_probes.append(row)
workspace_roots = [home, home / "work", home / "worktrees", home / "workspace"]
discovery = []
candidates = set()
for parent in (home / "work", home / "worktrees", home / "workspace"):
    entry_count = 0
    matched = []
    complete = True
    if parent.is_dir() and not parent.is_symlink():
        with os.scandir(parent) as it:
            for entry in it:
                entry_count += 1
                if entry_count > 512:
                    complete = False
                    break
                if "hepta" in entry.name.lower() or "codex" in entry.name.lower():
                    matched.append(str(parent / entry.name))
        candidates.update(matched)
    discovery.append({"parent": str(parent), "single_level_entries_considered": entry_count,
                      "complete_within_512_entry_bound": complete, "matching_paths": sorted(matched)})
known_paths = [
    home / "work/hepta-audit-native-target-20261103",
    home / "worktrees/hepta-audit-20261104-1230-hookmetadata",
    home / "worktrees/hepta-audit-cognitive-r3-20261104-1200",
    home / "work/hepta-audit-r3-fullgate-20261104",
]
candidates.update(map(str, known_paths))
path_metadata = []
repos = []
for text in sorted(candidates):
    p = Path(text)
    path_metadata.append(metadata(p))
    if not p.is_dir() or p.is_symlink():
        continue
    for rel in ("source", ".git", "source/.git", "codex-rs/target", "target",
                "target-app-epoch2-20261105", "tools/bin"):
        q = p / rel
        if q.exists() or q.is_symlink():
            path_metadata.append(metadata(q))
    for repo in (p, p / "source"):
        if (repo / ".git").exists() and repo.is_dir() and not repo.is_symlink():
            repos.append(repo)
git = shutil.which("git")
git_probes = []
seen_repos = set()
for repo in repos:
    if not git or str(repo) in seen_repos:
        continue
    seen_repos.add(str(repo))
    if len(seen_repos) > 20:
        errors.append({"scope": "git_identity", "reason": "more than20 bounded candidates; remaining not probed"})
        break
    r = version([git, "-C", str(repo), "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel", "--git-common-dir", "HEAD", "HEAD^{tree}"])
    git_probes.append({"repo": str(repo), "probe": r})
cache_paths = [
    home / ".cargo/registry", home / ".cargo/registry/src", home / ".cargo/registry/cache",
    home / ".cargo/git", home / ".cargo/git/db", home / ".cargo/git/checkouts",
    home / ".cache/bazel", home / ".cache/bazelisk",
    home / "work/hepta-audit-native-target-20261103",
    home / "work/hepta-audit-r3-fullgate-20261104/target-app-epoch2-20261105",
]
report = {"schema": "hepta-b16-alternative-host-readonly-readiness-v1", "configured_host": label,
          "started_at": started, "completed_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          "duration_seconds": time.monotonic() - clock,
          "user": {"uid": os.getuid(), "euid": os.geteuid(), "name": pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name,
                   "home": str(home)}, "uname": list(platform.uname()), "python": sys.version,
          "workspace_filesystems": [filesystem(p) for p in workspace_roots],
          "tools": tools, "installed_rust_toolchain_names": installed_toolchain_names,
          "concrete_installed_toolchain_version_probes": toolchain_probes,
          "bounded_single_level_discovery": discovery, "controlled_path_metadata": path_metadata,
          "read_only_git_identity_probes": git_probes,
          "known_cache_and_target_path_metadata": [metadata(p) for p in cache_paths],
          "errors": errors,
          "limits": ["No source or target/cache file was modified, installed, fetched, built, cleaned or recursively scanned.",
                     "Only version commands for native binaries and Git rev-parse were executed, all outside repository toolchain resolution except bounded Git -C.",
                     "Unknown Bazel wrappers and Rustup shim entries were not run; already installed concrete Rust toolchain binaries were used for version observations.",
                     "No remote URL, Git config, credential or full environment was read or printed.",
                     "Directory st_size/st_blocks is directory metadata, not a recursive cache/target allocation measurement.",
                     "ROG metadata/tool/binary/source qualification is not transferred by this survey."]}
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
